claim: Voice capture detects transport discontinuities, preserves one authoritative conversation and model runtime while reacquiring the physical input, and reports capture state separately from socket or lease state.
implemented: The duplex wire protocol carries monotonic device generations and active, recovering, muted, stopped, or unavailable capture states.
A capture discontinuity clears partial PCM, VAD, transcript, and speculative state so audio from two physical devices cannot become one utterance.
The browser detects track end, mute, unmute, and media-device changes, cleans partial getUserMedia initialization, and reacquires only the capture track inside the same authenticated voice socket.

The resident sounddevice owner detects inactive streams and callback stalls, retries bounded device opens without reloading ASR, TTS, conversation, or mind state, and exposes a generation-fenced device receipt.
A passive resident owner displaced by focused duplex voice registers a resource waiter and resumes only after the focused physical lease has actually released.
A timed-out PortAudio constructor retains its lease until the late handle is closed; authority transfer and recovery cannot overlap a still-opening CoreAudio device.
